title: [Switch] 13 Sentinels: Aegis Rim $21.23 (75% off) @ Nintendo eShop
body:
Deal: [Switch] 13 Sentinels: Aegis Rim $21.23 (75% off) @ Nintendo eShop

[mangobango] I see 13 Sentinels, I upvote.
Bought purely because it was Vanillaware without knowing much about it and it became one of my favourite games on PS4.
[thirdeyechai] Looking at DekuDeals this one is routinely on sale for this price. Not saying it's not a good deal, but since I'm busy with other games right now I don't need to worry about missing out on this by waiting to purchase it later.
[tebbybabes] Much thanks for that insight! I find myself in the same boat.
[Blitzfx] How does this compare to ps4 version? Thinking about playing it on Switch instead
[zonra] Very similar, Switch version adds some weapons/attacks for characters but doesn't change the game much.
I've beaten the game on both (one of my all time favorites) and didn't notice much difference in performance.
If you must pick I'd say switch for portability.
[Ventak] Pretty similar - both target 60fps, although have frame drops in high intensity battles (though some would argue that adds to the experience). If you have a PS5/Switch 2, both should iron out those performance issues. They have feature parity as well - Switch version introduced some balance adjustments and the PS4 version got those sometime afterwards.
[Blitzfx] I got a PS5 and a Switch 2 funnily enough.
Have you checked it works smoothly with Switch 2?
[lemonteaorz] I used to play it on switch lite, 30 FPS is kinda painful in battle mode. Then finished it with emulator on PC, very smooth, nothing to complain. Nice game.
[Kingfield] Good game but need a lot of commitment to get through the text heavy start. I think I bought it 2+ years ago and only in the process of properly getting into it and finishing it off now after about 3 separate attempts to get into it
